name: What should I consider before starting a whole-home remodel?

mainEntity.name: What should I consider before starting a whole-home remodel?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before starting, consider your budget and financing options, as well as your desired timeline for completion. Clearly define your vision for the space, including preferred styles, functionalities, and must-have features. Research local zoning laws and permit requirements, as these can impact your project. Think about how you'll manage living arrangements during construction. Finally, research and select a reputable general contractor who understands your needs and can execute your vision effectively.
acceptedAnswer.description: Before starting a remodel, consider your budget, timeline, design vision, local permits, living arrangements during construction, and choosing a reputable contractor.
